observations.summary: President Zelenskiy reports several days of military satellite connectivity speed restrictions around 161 km/h, after a similar restriction was lifted October 24. He says interceptors were affected; cause and independent technical confirmation remain unknown. Reuters published his statement at 10:09 UTC on November 12. This is a reported operational impairment, not proof of intentional US action or Russian escalation.
observations.title: Ukraine reports renewed Starshield mobility restrictions affecting drone interception
